mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE AND a.achievement_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN m.effective_start_date AND COALESCE(m.effective_end_date, DATE '9999-12-31') ORDER BY m.organization_code

SELECT p.evaluation_year FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND (p.organization_code IS NULL OR p.organization_code = #{organization}) AND (p.user_type_code IS NULL OR p.user_type_code = 'FACULTY') AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at ORDER BY p.setting_id

SELECT m.management_item_code, m.management_item_name, e.evaluation_year, m.required_yn, m.data_type, m.teacher_editable_yn FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_rule_versions r ON r.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id WHERE m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND r.version_status != 'DISCARDED' ORDER BY e.evaluation_year DESC, m.sort_order, m.management_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
